title: Curation Quarantine Dataset
purpose: Restricted curation output containing physical records rejected during parsing, key validation, ingest validation, or winner validation, together with rejection reasons and provenance.

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: S3 object location of the original source record.

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: Physical row number within the original source object.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the original source object.

columns.name: stage
columns.meaning: Pipeline stage at which the record was quarantined.

columns.name: primary_reason
columns.meaning: Primary reason the record failed validation.

columns.name: all_reasons
columns.meaning: Complete set of validation failure reasons associated with the quarantined record.

columns.name: raw_payload
columns.meaning: Preserved raw payload of the rejected physical record.
